findings.description: CON-SUP-107, CON-SUP-124 and CON-SUP-129 do not establish whether the byte at __app_end is included in the CRC input. SYS-SUP-016 therefore admits different CRC inputs.
findings.requested_change: Obtain a product decision on the application CRC endpoint and specify the resulting range.

findings.description: CON-SUP-142 does not establish whether the byte at __cfg_end is included in the configuration CRC input. SYS-SUP-018 therefore admits different CRC inputs.
findings.requested_change: Obtain a product decision on the configuration CRC endpoint and specify the resulting range.

findings.description: Coverage of CON-SUP-142 is partial because the configuration CRC endpoint is ambiguous. OP-SYS-005 records the missing product decision.
findings.requested_change: Resolve OP-SYS-005 and specify the configuration CRC range.
